original.subject: Live hit at 6:45?
original.body: Could someone from Millbrook water join us live at 6:45 to talk about water use in the heat wave — and whether Millbrook’s pipes can take it? Five minutes, by phone is fine.

snapshot.title: Chlorine Residual Alarm — Clearwell 2

fields.subject: FW: AIT-611 Disinfection Failure Alert — 05:25
fields.note: The AIT-611 chlorine residual analyzer at the Orchard Standpipe outlet has not reported since 05:25. Last reading: 0.3 mg/L. No new data. This suggests a loss of disinfection or a telemetry failure at the site. I recommend initiating emergency sampling from Zone 2. Please confirm if the failure is due to telemetry or a real loss of residual.

original.subject: Disinfection Failure Alert — AIT-611
original.body:
Last report received: 05:25.
Status: AIT-611 outlet chlorine residual at Orchard Standpipe.
Last value: 0.3 mg/L.
No new data received.
Alarm: AIT-611 output has not updated in 30 minutes.
Suggestion: Verify with grab sample; check for telemetry loss or actual residual drop.
This alert is automatically generated by the SCADA system and is not manually overridden.

— AIT-611 (Orchard Standpipe) | MDWS-SCADA-APP-A | 10.72.20.10 | RTU-02 | C1, C4, C5

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms telemetry failure at the Orchard Standpipe. The WQ must now initiate emergency sampling and alert operations that disinfection status is unknown, setting up the Boil Water Advisory decision point.
